confidence: Moderately high on Art, conditional on witness accuracy and no accomplice; material alone is expressly nonunique.
plausibility_notes: Vial supports extraction-and-carrying mechanism and was reasonably foreshadowed by preparation sample containers.
Unlocked preview plus assistant departure supplies credible extraction interval, though carelessness is convenient.
Clear kitchen/prop samples exclude those poison vehicles, not automatically people associated with them.
Chemical consistency and common stock establish compatibility rather than unique origin or handler.
Late arrivals exclude personal preview extraction only if arrival statements are accepted; accomplice routes are unsupported alternatives, not positive evidence.
